send_user_invitation_email: send an email invitation to a new user after adding them to the team
send_key_created_email: send an email notification to a user when their virtual API key is created
send_key_rotated_email: send an email notification to a user when their virtual API key is rotated
budget_alerts: send budget alert emails when soft budget or max budget thresholds are crossed
send_email: send an HTML email to recipients with a custom subject and body content
